lines.text: Which statement about the human immunodeficiency virus, HIV, is true?
The answer is: it establishes persistence through antigenic variation.
Here is HIV, grinning as it tries on yet another mask.
Behind it hangs a whole wall of masks. This is antigenic variation: the virus keeps changing its surface antigens.
In the mirror, it hides behind a disguise, so the immune system cannot recognise it.
One infected patient carries a huge number of HIV variants during the course of infection.
(sigh) The immune cells are buried under the masks. The immune system is swamped, and finally collapses.
Remember: HIV establishes persistence through antigenic variation.
Typical physical and laboratory findings in hyperthyroidism include which of the following?
Look at his neck. The thyroid is on fire. This man has hyperthyroidism.
His hand shakes so much that the tea spills from the glass. That is tremor.
(laugh) And the other hand is trembling too.
Inside, his heart beats a fast drum. That is tachycardia.
Hyperthyroidism also brings a low serum cholesterol and brisk reflexes, called hyperreflexia.
All the other options are classical findings of hypothyroidism, the opposite state.
Remember: an overactive thyroid shakes the hands. Tremor is a typical finding in hyperthyroidism.
